name: A Dwarf and His Tools
summary: Prospector Ryedol escaped an attack on his dig site and now seeks his lucky pick. Dark Iron dwarves resembling the Shadowforge clan are all around.

sections.title: Raiders at the Dig
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves resembling the Shadowforge clan attacked the excavation site where Ryedol worked. Nearly everyone died, including his boss, Hammertoe. Ryedol barely escaped with his life. The site lies north of where he waits.

sections.title: A Lucky Pick
sections.body: Prospector Ryedol is trying to recover supplies lost in the attack, especially his lucky pick. One of the Dark Iron dwarves has it, though Ryedol does not know which one. He hopes you will help and waits south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.

aliases: who gives a dwarf and his tools
faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol worked at an excavation site attacked by Dark Iron dwarves. He barely escaped and now waits south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
Dark Iron dwarves resembling the Shadowforge clan attacked the excavation site.
Hammertoe was Ryedol's boss and was among those killed in the attack.

faq.q: Where is the lucky pick located?
faq.answer: Ryedol believes one of the Dark Iron dwarves has the lucky pick, though he does not know which one.
